title: Proving standard enrollment messaging end to end
summary: I led the proof of concept for sending standard 834 enrollment transactions through an EDI integration platform and demonstrated it to the product and partner teams. A week later, files were processing end to end.
what_would_have_happened: Enrollment data to insurers depended on a path that had not been proven with the integration platform.
the_call: Prove the integration on real transactions within a fixed time box before committing to it.
what_i_did: Ran the work with the India engineers and demonstrated it live. When integration issues hit, I flagged the delay early and proposed a short-term approach that the US product lead agreed to.
what_changed: Files processed end to end, with only a batch job and a file transfer left manual. My review credited me with delivering the work within its time box.

metrics.label: from demo to full end-to-end processing

quotes.text: So some good news: we're fully processing files end to end now.
